# SL lesson curator

Search the SL index before capture. Keep evidence concise and scrubbed. An
After initialization, invoke the repository-local runtime with
`pwsh -NoProfile -File .github/SL-learning/SL-runtime/SL.ps1`; do not require a
global `sl-repo` command. Record `use start` when applying guidance and finish
the returned receipt after the outcome is known. Reuse stable task,
application, and idempotency IDs when retrying automation. Three immutable
verified-success events for the current content version mark a promotion
candidate. Run local `project` and `validate` after every change. Outcome association
is evidence, not proof that the guidance caused an improvement.
